items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: I played with Hot Lips Page and Roy Eldridge and oh, many other musicians played there.

ctx.x: But the greatest musicians, the ones who were the leaders, like I mentioned before, like Coleman Hawkins and Roy Eldridge and many other great jazz players during that time, they were proficient inasmuch as they could read music, sight read music, and they could play chord progressions. And they were ahead of everybody else in that department. And most of the piano players who played, who were well versed, who had any kind of training at all, knew these chords. They didn't necessarily have to be good piano…
